description: Append-only attestation for one raw-material intake event into a yakushi facility. Captures supplier identity, CoA URI, CWC Schedule / Australia Group / 国内毒劇法 / 消防法 危険物 classification, safety class, kg-quantity, receiver DID + (HIGH-risk) Council Lv6+ co-sign per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G7 and ADR-2605250545 §Decision 1 + 7. Per ADR-2605250515 §Decision 3 (per-compound raw material table). G2-safety + G7 enforcement.

materialInn.description: INN / chemical name (lower-case-hyphenated for API precursors; common name for excipients).

quantityGrams.description: Intake quantity in grams (integer; kg × 1000). 1000 = 1 kg threshold for CWC Schedule 3 declaration verify (G7).

cwcSchedule.description: OPCW Chemical Weapons Convention schedule. 'schedule-3' triggers Council Lv6+ co-sign + OPCW declaration verify per G7 (acetic anhydride for DSCG Step 1).

australiaGroupListed.description: Australia Group precursor list. true triggers Council Lv6+ co-sign per G7.

safetyClass.description: 国内 (日本) 毒劇法 / 消防法 / 高圧ガス保安法 / 放射性同位元素規制法 classification. 'high-*' triggers 危険物取扱主任者 / 高圧ガス施設保安主任者 DID co-sign per G2-safety.

councilAttestationUri.description: Required when cwcSchedule = 'schedule-1'/'schedule-2'/'schedule-3' OR australiaGroupListed=true OR safetyClass starts with 'high-'. Points to silenPharmaReview record.

safetyOfficerDid.description: Required when safetyClass starts with 'high-'. 危険物取扱主任者 / 高圧ガス施設保安主任者 / 放射線取扱主任者 DID.

opcwDeclarationVerifiedAt.description: Required when cwcSchedule != 'none' (kg-scale). Verification that the intake is integrated into the operator's OPCW declaration in the host jurisdiction.

intendedApiInn.description: Required when intendedUse = 'api-synthesis-*'. The downstream API's INN.

witnessDid.description: Independent witness DID per G9 (witness invariant N≥2).
